001package io.jstach.rainbowgum.rolling;
002
003import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogConfig;
004import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogOutput;
005import io.jstach.rainbowgum.file.FileOutput;
006import io.jstach.rainbowgum.spi.RainbowGumServiceProvider;
007import io.jstach.svc.ServiceProvider;
008
009/**
010 * Registers the two URI schemes {@code rainbowgum-file} provides:
011 * {@value LogOutput#FILE_SCHEME} (so {@code file:///path/to/app.log} resolves to a
012 * {@link FileOutput} - {@code core} on its own has no such registration) and
013 * {@value RollingFileOutput#ROLLING_SCHEME} (so {@code rolling:///path/to/app.log}
014 * resolves to a {@link RollingFileOutput}).
015 */
016@ServiceProvider(RainbowGumServiceProvider.class)
017public class RollingConfigurator implements RainbowGumServiceProvider.Configurator {
018
019        /**
020         * No arg for service loader.
021         */
022        public RollingConfigurator() {
023        }
024
025        @Override
026        public boolean configure(LogConfig config, Pass pass) {
027                config.outputRegistry().register(LogOutput.FILE_SCHEME, FileOutput::of);
028                config.outputRegistry().register(RollingFileOutput.ROLLING_SCHEME, RollingFileOutput::of);
029                return true;
030        }
031
032}
